body:
Checking all items from chapter references
* link is still alive?
* reference in correct chapter?
* reference still up to date by content?
* reference is not too technology specific / niche and not covered by owasp cheat sheet reference?
* Is it a non-OWASP or non-RFC refererence? Do we absolutely have to have it? Is there a risk that someone will change it out from under us?
* Do we need to use groups in the references section to tidy it up?
* format sync over references
  * OWASP Cheat Sheet
  * OWASP Web Security Testing Guide
  * RFC
